dedupe_keys.name: alphabuilding synthetic building generation and analysis code

description: The AlphaBuilding GitHub repository provides source code and notebooks for producing and examining a synthetic office-building operations dataset. Its README specifies OpenStudio workflows, Ruby setup, simulation options and a Python example for extracting raw outputs. Modellers can adapt the workflow to generate controlled HVAC, lighting, occupancy and electricity-load cases for building control or demand simulations. The published data were created for selected office buildings and three climates; alternative building types require code and input checks, and synthetic behaviour is not direct measured occupancy. GitHub reports MIT for the repository. I read own repository metadata and documentation without cloning, installing OpenStudio or reproducing the large OEDI output. The related OEDI data already exist in catalogue record data-lbnl-alphabuilding-synthetic-operation-dataset. This code is a distinct reusable resource that the earlier title screen did not check. The published run covers a medium office archetype in Miami, San Francisco and Chicago; other climates need new simulations.
